name: Ymir
requirement: Sega Saturn emulator (GPL-3.0). Needs a Saturn IPL (BIOS) ROM you dumped yourself: mpr-17933.bin for North American and European discs, sega_101.bin for Japanese discs. Drop it into the BIOS inbox. Saves, settings and save states stay in Marquee's Ymir folder.

firmware.name: mpr-17933.bin
firmware.note: Saturn IPL v1.00/1.01 for North American and European discs. One IPL matching the disc's region is required.

firmware.name: sega_101.bin
firmware.note: Saturn IPL v1.01 for Japanese discs.

firmware.name: sega_100.bin
firmware.note: Saturn IPL v1.00 for Japanese discs; an alternative to sega_101.bin.
